description: Connect the tenant's AbaNinja account. Required: token (API token from Settings > Company > API Tokens), account_uuid (from Account Information). The connection is tested BEFORE anything is stored, and the real status is what gets saved — an unreachable account is recorded as unreachable, never as working. The token is write-only; no tool result ever returns it. Use this once per tenant before any other abaninja tool.

account_uuid.description: The account UUID; it is part of every API path.

base_url.description: Only for testing; defaults to https://api.abaninja.ch

token.description: AbaNinja API token (sent as Authorization: Bearer).

name: set_abaninja_credentials
